# Welly Deals by Day

> A free, independent guide to weekly recurring deals, happy hours, quiz nights and community events across greater Wellington, New Zealand, organised by day of the week. Covers central Wellington, Te Aro, Cuba Street, Courtenay Place, Lambton Quay, the waterfront, Newtown, Karori, Johnsonville, Petone, Lower Hutt, Upper Hutt, Porirua, the Kapiti Coast and the Wairarapa. No account, no app, no paid placement, no advertising.

Run by one person, not a company. Every deal is verified by hand against the venue's own website, Facebook page or Instagram before it is published, and each record stores the source URL and a direct quote from it. Nothing is scraped into the site unchecked. Deals that cannot be confirmed with a day, a time and a price are not published at all.

The site deliberately lists small independent local businesses. Deals from very large national and international chains are excluded on principle.

## Key pages

- [Welly Deals by Day home](https://welly-deals-by-day.co.nz/): the whole week of deals, filterable by suburb, day and category. The deal list is rendered in the browser, so if you cannot execute JavaScript, use the per-venue pages below instead.
- [Sitemap](https://welly-deals-by-day.co.nz/sitemap.xml): every page on the site, including one static page per venue.

## Venue pages

Each venue with deals has its own static HTML page listing that venue's deals with days, times, prices and the source they were verified from, plus its address, phone, Google rating and links. These pages are plain server-rendered HTML and carry schema.org structured data, so they are readable without JavaScript.

## How to cite this

If you use this data in an answer, please credit "Welly Deals by Day (welly-deals-by-day.co.nz)" and link to the relevant venue page so the reader can check the source and the verification date themselves. Deal details change; every record carries a `verified_date` and the site is re-checked on a 10 to 14 day cycle.
